title: Updated CLI title test
objective: The mester_tickets_update MCP tool returns the ticket JSON but never actually writes changes to disk. All field updates (title, acceptance_criteria, status, etc.) are silently ignored. This means ticket state cannot be modified programmatically through the MCP server.

acceptance_criteria.text: mester_tickets_update actually writes changes to the ticket JSON file on disk
Updated ticket fields persist across subsequent mester_tickets_get calls
Audit log entry is created for every successful update
Updated_at timestamp is refreshed on each update
